title: Technology Sector Update for 11/30/2018: WDAY,ANBA,ASYS
text:

Technology stocks were firming Friday afternoon, with shares of technology companies in the S&P 500 index adding about 0.2% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor index was inching 0.1% higher.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Workday ( WDAY ) climbed more than 13% to a new record high on Friday, reaching a best-ever $166.19 after reporting better-than-expected Q3 net income. Net income for the three months ended Oct. 31 grew to $0.31 per share from $0.24 per share last year and easily beating the Capital IQ consensus expecting a year-over-year drop to $0.14 per share.
In other sector news:
(+) Ambarella ( AMBA ) jumped 19% after the specialty chipmaker reported Q3 financial results exceeding Wall Street expectations. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $0.21 per share on $57.3 million in revenue compared with the Capital IQ consensus expecting a $0.09 per share non-GAAP profit on $57.2 million in revenue.
(-) Amtech Systems ( ASYS ) retreated almost 19% at one point on Friday after its fiscal Q4 net loss expanded to $0.61 per share compared with a $0.51 per share loss during the year-ago period and missing the Capital IQ consensus expecting a net loss of $0.17 per share. The solar-cell components company also is projecting fiscal Q1 revenue in a range of $27 million to $29 million, lagging the analyst mean by at least $3.1 million.
